The '''Aleen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It had at least one [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]].<ref name="NoP" />
